newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines says offering new fares.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines says offering new fares.

text.p: Southwest Airlines said Friday it was offering fares of $99 one-way for new nonstop service between New Orleans and Phoenix, Louisville and Phoenix, and Nashville and Columbus.
The company also said it is offering $68 one-way fares with roundtrip purchases for new non-stop service Kansas City and the West Coast.
The company also said it is offering $99 one-way fares with roundtrip purchass for service between Chicago Midway and Los Angeles, Louisville and Los Angeles, and New Orleans and Los Angeles.
The company said the fares are available for purchase through June 10 for travel June 11 through October 24.
Nonstop service between Kansas City and Los Angeles, between Kansas City and Oakland, and between Nashville and Columbus begins June 11.

On the same day, Southwest will begin nonstop service between New Orleans and Phoenix and between Louisville and Phoenix. This new service also opens up one-stop same plane travel from Chicago Midway, Louisville, and New Orleans to Los Angeles.
